scope: Isolated Originator-SCCP-Address exclusion on combined ECUR INITIAL and TERMINATION
boundaries: Source-derived INITIAL and TERMINATION negatives each add one NUL-free Originator-SCCP-Address. Applicable only with both valid interface types, valid downstream operation fields and an otherwise valid request.
Quoted length is 36 bytes plus four-byte-aligned payload. Shared decoder counters include both interface children. The padded field is owned. Exact and short quote and answer budgets are checked.

Malformed NUL address retains earlier 5004. Extra action, timestamp mismatch, interface, unit/status and extra-field mixtures retain their validation order. Pure Go TCP/TLS loopback under both inbound policies.
initial_regression: The historical interface matrix expected the single-field local path for two newly attributed Receive cases. Its expectations now distinguish only those isolated cases from the unchanged mixed and Build/Send cases.
